Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and the clear list.

Short answer up front: we support SCCs and offer a DPF-based transfer option for approved customers; we also provide a transfer matrix and a proposed DPA annex. Attached are three artifacts to start: a draft DPA annex (redwood_dpa_annex_v1.2.pdf), a transfer matrix (redwood-data-transfer-matrix.xlsx), and a short SCC reference note (scc-reference-guidance.pdf).

High-level details:
- Controls: data at rest in our hosted environment is segmented per-customer. Inference may occur in regions you specify — for EU customers we can pin to an EU region or route via SCC-protected transfers.
- Legal mechanisms: our standard path is SCCs for EU->US transfers; for customers that require DPF we support a documented DPF-based program that includes contractual commitments, technical controls, and annual attestation. DPF is available subject to customer review and a short onboarding checklist.
- Evidence: the attached draft annex references the contractual clauses and points to our attestation cadence; we can provide a copy of the DPF-reporting pack under NDA if you need the detailed artifacts.

Next step: if the attachments look OK, Marissa can run through the matrix and call out any technical implementation constraints; Priyom can propose precise annex language or redlines for your counsel. Happy to set a 30-min call with your legal team later this week.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
